sports-fitness-fitness-yoga-mats.name: Non-slip Yoga Mat
sports-fitness-fitness-yoga-mats.description: This 6 mm mat is made from closed-cell foam with a textured surface on both sides. It measures 183 x 61 cm and rolls up for storage.

reviews.body: The textured top stays put on my tiled floor and my hands do not slide. Good thickness for everyday practice.
Arrived rolled tightly in a plastic sleeve. Smells a little at first but it faded after a day near the window.

sports-fitness-fitness-yoga-mats.name: Folding Travel Yoga Mat
sports-fitness-fitness-yoga-mats.description: A thin 1.5 mm mat that folds into a flat square and fits inside a standard backpack. It is made from natural rubber with a fine grip pattern.

reviews.body: Folds small enough for my gym bag and weighs almost nothing. I lay it over the hotel carpet and it works fine.
Very thin, so I put a towel under my knees. Fine for a travel mat but not for a hard floor every day.

sports-fitness-fitness-yoga-mats.name: Extra Thick Exercise Mat
sports-fitness-fitness-yoga-mats.description: This 15 mm mat is made from soft NBR foam and comes with an elastic carry strap. It measures 180 x 60 cm and is meant for floor exercises and stretching.

reviews.body: Really cushioned under the knees during floor work. The carry strap is a nice extra.
Quite bulky when rolled, so it does not fit in my cupboard easily. The foam has held its shape after a month.

sports-fitness-fitness-yoga-mats.name: Cork Top Yoga Mat
sports-fitness-fitness-yoga-mats.description: The top layer is natural cork bonded to a 5 mm rubber base. It measures 183 x 61 cm and can be wiped clean with a damp cloth.

reviews.body: Grip actually improves when my palms get damp. It looks quite nice on the floor too.
Solid build and the cork edges are neatly finished. Delivery was quick and the box was not dented.

sports-fitness-fitness-yoga-mats.name: Natural Rubber Yoga Mat
sports-fitness-fitness-yoga-mats.description: A 4 mm mat made from natural rubber with a suede-like top and a ridged underside. It measures 185 x 68 cm and weighs about 2.4 kg.

reviews.body: Heavy enough that it never curls at the corners. The underside grips the wooden floor well.
Has a rubber smell for the first week, then it settles. The size is generous for taller people.

sports-fitness-fitness-yoga-mats.name: Kids Yoga Mat
sports-fitness-fitness-yoga-mats.description: A 4 mm foam mat for juniors, measuring 120 x 50 cm, with a printed animal pattern on one side. The surface is smooth and easy to wipe.

reviews.body: My daughter picked it herself because of the print. Right size for her and easy to roll without help.
Colours look just like the photos. Corners are a bit stiff to roll at first.

sports-fitness-fitness-yoga-mats.name: Extra Long Wide Yoga Mat
sports-fitness-fitness-yoga-mats.description: This 8 mm mat measures 200 x 80 cm and is made from dense TPE foam. The wide surface gives room for sprawling floor exercises.

reviews.body: Finally a mat where my feet and hands both fit. It is wide enough to share with my partner.
Takes up a lot of space in a small room. Material feels firm and does not stretch.

sports-fitness-fitness-yoga-mats.name: Printed Yoga Mat with Strap
sports-fitness-fitness-yoga-mats.description: A 6 mm PVC-free foam mat with a mandala print on the top face and a cotton carry strap included. It measures 183 x 61 cm.

reviews.body: The print is sharp and has not rubbed off yet after many washes with a cloth. Strap is useful on the way to class.
Packed with care and arrived two days early. Good value for the thickness you get.

sports-fitness-fitness-dumbbells.name: Rubber Hex Dumbbell 8 kg
sports-fitness-fitness-dumbbells.description: A single 8 kg dumbbell with a hexagonal rubber-coated head and a knurled steel handle. The flat sides stop it from rolling on the floor.

reviews.body: Does not roll anywhere and the rubber does not mark my floor. Knurling gives a firm hold without scratching.
Weight matches what is printed on it. Slight rubber smell when it arrived.

sports-fitness-fitness-dumbbells.name: Neoprene Dumbbell Pair 2 kg
sports-fitness-fitness-dumbbells.description: A pair of 2 kg dumbbells with a soft neoprene coating over cast iron. The coating is available in matching colours for easy identification.

reviews.body: Comfortable to hold and the colour is bright. Both dumbbells weigh the same on my kitchen scale.
Good for light routines at home. The coating feels a little sticky in the monsoon humidity.

sports-fitness-fitness-dumbbells.name: Adjustable Dumbbell 20 kg
sports-fitness-fitness-dumbbells.description: This set includes two handles, steel plates and spin-lock collars that together total 20 kg. Plates can be added or removed to change the weight.

reviews.body: Saves a lot of space compared with buying many pairs. Changing plates takes a minute, which is fine.
The collars tighten properly and nothing rattled. Came with a small spanner and clear packaging.

sports-fitness-fitness-dumbbells.name: Vinyl Dumbbell Set 1 kg
sports-fitness-fitness-dumbbells.description: Two 1 kg dumbbells coated in smooth vinyl with a rounded grip. They come with a small plastic stand for tidy storage.

reviews.body: Light and easy for beginners. The stand keeps them from rolling off the shelf.
Does the job but the vinyl feels thin and the stand is flimsy. Ordered it for my mother and she is fine with it.

sports-fitness-fitness-dumbbells.name: Cast Iron Dumbbell 10 kg
sports-fitness-fitness-dumbbells.description: A single 10 kg dumbbell cast in one piece of iron with a black painted finish. The handle has a diamond pattern for grip.

reviews.body: Feels like a proper piece of iron and there are no loose parts. The paint has stayed intact so far.
Handle is a bit thick for smaller hands. Courier brought it in a sturdy carton.

sports-fitness-fitness-dumbbells.name: Round Rubber Dumbbell 4 kg
sports-fitness-fitness-dumbbells.description: A pair of 4 kg dumbbells with round rubber heads and a chrome-plated handle. The round heads suit exercises where the weights are held upright.

reviews.body: Neat finish on the chrome and the heads are firmly attached. Good weight for my upper-body routine.
The pair arrived in separate boxes but both on the same day. Handles are smooth rather than rough.

sports-fitness-fitness-dumbbells.name: Hand Weight Pair with Strap
sports-fitness-fitness-dumbbells.description: Two 0.5 kg hand weights, each with an adjustable hook-and-loop strap over the back of the hand. They are filled with iron sand and covered in soft fabric.

reviews.body: The strap holds on well during brisk walks. I forget I am wearing them after a few minutes.
Stitching is neat and the fabric is soft on my skin. Light enough to carry in a handbag.

sports-fitness-fitness-dumbbells.name: Chrome Handle Dumbbell 6 kg
sports-fitness-fitness-dumbbells.description: A single 6 kg dumbbell with a chrome-plated steel handle and two black rubber-coated ends. The handle is 12 cm long with a light knurled pattern.

reviews.body: Looks good and sits well in the palm. The ends are tight with no wobble when I lift it.
A bit pricey for one piece, but the build is better than the cheaper ones I tried.

sports-fitness-fitness-resistance-bands.name: Loop Band Set of 5
sports-fitness-fitness-resistance-bands.description: Five latex loop bands in different resistance levels, each 60 cm around. The set comes in a mesh pouch with a printed guide sheet.

reviews.body: All five bands feel clearly different in tension. The mesh pouch keeps them together in my drawer.
No tears or sticky patches. The guide sheet is basic but easy to follow.

sports-fitness-fitness-resistance-bands.name: Tube Band with Handles
sports-fitness-fitness-resistance-bands.description: A 120 cm latex tube band with padded foam handles and metal clips at each end. It also includes a carry bag and two ankle straps.

reviews.body: Handles are comfortable and the clips snap firmly. Ankle straps were a pleasant surprise in the box.
Tension is a little stronger than the label suggests for me. Carry bag is handy for the park.

sports-fitness-fitness-resistance-bands.name: Fabric Hip Band
sports-fitness-fitness-resistance-bands.description: A wide band made of cotton and rubber thread, sized to fit around the thighs. The inner side has a grippy strip so it stays in place.

reviews.body: Does not roll up or slide down the way plain rubber ones do. Fabric feels soft against my legs.
Washes well in cold water and dries quickly. Size medium fit me perfectly.

sports-fitness-fitness-resistance-bands.name: Long Pull-up Band
sports-fitness-fitness-resistance-bands.description: A 104 cm closed-loop band made of thick natural latex, 4.5 cm wide. It can be anchored to a bar or used for stretching.

reviews.body: Feels very solid and thick. Wrapped around my pull-up bar without slipping.
Works but has a strong rubber smell and left a slight mark on my wall. Stretching it a few times helped.

sports-fitness-fitness-resistance-bands.name: Mini Loop Band 30 cm
sports-fitness-fitness-resistance-bands.description: A short 30 cm loop band in medium tension, made from a single piece of elastic latex. It is small enough to carry in a pocket.

reviews.body: Tiny and light, so it travels with me everywhere. Has not lost its stretch over several weeks.
Only one band in the pack, so check the quantity before you order. Quality is fine.

sports-fitness-fitness-resistance-bands.name: Door Anchor Band Kit
sports-fitness-fitness-resistance-bands.description: This kit has three tube bands, a door anchor, two handles and a storage bag. The anchor fits over a closed door of normal thickness.

reviews.body: The door anchor held without damaging the paint. It gave me a lot of variety in a small room.
Instructions are very short, so I watched some videos. Parts feel sturdy for the price.

sports-fitness-fitness-resistance-bands.name: Figure-8 Band
sports-fitness-fitness-resistance-bands.description: A figure-8 shaped band with soft foam grips on both loops. It is 35 cm long and made of light tension latex.

reviews.body: Foam grips are comfortable and easy to hold. Good for light arm exercises in front of the TV.
Compact, well stitched at the joins and packed neatly. My father uses it every morning.

sports-fitness-fitness-resistance-bands.name: Flat Latex Exercise Band
sports-fitness-fitness-resistance-bands.description: A 150 cm long flat latex strip, 15 cm wide, sold in light tension. It can be cut to length or tied into a loop.

reviews.body: Length is generous and I tied it to a pillar for stretching. Rubber feels fresh and not brittle.
Slightly powdery when it arrived, so wipe it once. Otherwise exactly as described.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cricket.name: Full Size Willow Bat
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cricket.description: A size 6 cricket bat made from willow with a cane handle and a rubber grip. It weighs about 1.2 kg and comes with a cover.

reviews.body: Balanced well and the pickup feels natural. Edges are cleanly finished and the cover is included.
Needed a bit of knocking in with a mallet before use. Handle grip feels firm.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cricket.name: Junior Willow Bat Size 3
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cricket.description: A size 3 willow bat for juniors, around 800 g, with a short cane handle. It has a pre-applied anti-scuff sheet on the face.

reviews.body: My son can swing it without struggling. The anti-scuff sheet is already stuck on neatly.
Looks good and light. I had to check the age chart carefully to pick the right size.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cricket.name: Tennis Ball Cricket Bat
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cricket.description: A wide-blade bat made from poplar wood with a flat face, intended for use with soft tennis balls. It weighs around 1 kg and has a taped handle.

reviews.body: Perfect for gully cricket in the colony. The tape on the handle gives a good hold.
Strong enough to survive a whole summer of weekend matches. Reached me well wrapped.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cricket.name: Leather Match Ball Red
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cricket.description: A 156 g four-piece cricket ball with a cork core and red dyed leather cover. The seam is hand-stitched.

reviews.body: Seam is raised and clearly visible, and the ball kept its shape through a full practice session.
Colour is a deep red and the weight matches the label. Slightly slippery when new.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cricket.name: Tennis Cricket Ball Pack of 6
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cricket.description: Six medium-hard rubber balls wrapped in a tennis ball cover, each about 60 g. They are made for open grounds and street games.

reviews.body: Six balls at this price lasts our group a long while. They bounce evenly.
A couple of them lost their fuzz sooner than others. The pack was sealed properly.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cricket.name: Batting Gloves
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cricket.description: Right-handed batting gloves with a cotton palm, foam-padded fingers and a hook-and-loop wrist strap. They are available in men's medium size.

reviews.body: Fingers are padded without being stiff, and the wrist strap is easy to adjust. Fit is true to size.
The palm is soft and the stitching held through nets sessions. Came with a small bag.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cricket.name: Batting Pads Pair
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cricket.description: A pair of lightweight batting leg pads with a foam core, canvas cover and three buckle straps. They are sized for teenagers and smaller players.

reviews.body: Light enough to run in and the straps are long enough. Foam does not feel crumbly.
Good for club practice. The buckles needed a bit of effort to thread the first time.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cricket.name: Wooden Stumps Set with Bails
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cricket.description: A set of three seasoned wooden stumps, two bails and a carry sleeve. Each stump is 71 cm tall and has a pointed steel-tipped base.

reviews.body: The tips go into hard ground easily and the wood is smooth. Bails sit well on top of the stumps.
One stump had a small crack along the grain. Seller replied quickly but I kept it as the set still worked.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-badminton.name: Graphite Badminton Racket
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-badminton.description: A 85 g racket with a graphite shaft and aluminium frame, strung at 22 lb. It comes with a full-length cover.

reviews.body: Very light in the hand and the strings feel tight. Cover is padded and zips fully.
Good for regular club play. The grip is a little thin, so I added an overgrip.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-badminton.name: Beginner Racket Pair
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-badminton.description: Two aluminium rackets with a steel shaft, pre-strung and sold with three nylon shuttlecocks. They come in a shared carry bag.

reviews.body: Good set for the family to start with. Strings are fine, though not for hard smashes.
Everything in one bag and it was at our door in two days. The kids played on the very first evening.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-badminton.name: Feather Shuttlecock Tube
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-badminton.description: A tube of 12 shuttlecocks with goose feathers and a cork base wrapped in thin leather. Speed rating is medium for indoor courts.

reviews.body: Flight is steady and they last longer than I expected for the price. Tube was sealed on arrival.
Feathers are neatly aligned. Slightly faster than my old ones in our cool hall.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-badminton.name: Nylon Shuttlecock Tube
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-badminton.description: A tube of 10 nylon-skirt shuttlecocks with a cork head, intended for casual and outdoor play. The skirt is built to resist bending.

reviews.body: Handles a light breeze in our park better than feather ones. They survived many rallies.
Fine for casual games but two of the ten had an uneven head. They flew okay for practice.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-badminton.name: Racket Grip Tape Pack
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-badminton.description: A pack of 10 overgrips made from a soft polyurethane layer with a tacky surface. Each strip is 110 cm long and comes in assorted colours.

reviews.body: Easy to wrap and the finish is tacky even when my hand is sweaty. Ten pieces will last me months.
Colours are mixed and you cannot choose them. Tape quality is the same as the pricier ones I bought before.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-badminton.name: Indoor Court Shoes
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-badminton.description: Lightweight court shoes with a gum rubber sole and a breathable mesh upper. They are meant for use on wooden and synthetic indoor courts.

reviews.body: Sole grips the court without squeaking too much. I ordered one size larger as advised in the reviews.
Comfortable from the first game and the mesh stays cool. Box arrived intact.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-badminton.name: Racket Kit Bag 3-Compartment
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-badminton.description: A polyester bag with three zipped compartments, a padded shoulder strap and room for up to six rackets. It also has a side pocket for a water bottle.

reviews.body: Plenty of room for rackets, shoes and a towel. Zips run smoothly and the strap does not dig in.
Stitching looks tidy. The colour is slightly darker than shown online.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-badminton.name: Portable Badminton Net Set
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-badminton.description: A 3 m wide net with two adjustable steel poles, guy ropes and a carry bag. It sets up on grass, sand or a driveway in a few minutes.

reviews.body: We set it up in our building compound in ten minutes. The poles stayed straight with the ropes pulled tight.
Net mesh is good and the bag is useful. Pegs could be a little longer for soft ground.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cycling.name: Adjustable Cycling Helmet
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cycling.description: A lightweight helmet with an in-moulded foam shell, 18 vents and a rear dial for adjusting the fit. It fits head sizes from 54 to 60 cm.

reviews.body: The dial makes it easy to adjust in seconds, and the vents keep my head cooler on long rides. Padding is soft.
Looks good and weighs very little. Chin strap took a few tries to set properly.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cycling.name: Steel Water Bottle with Cage
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cycling.description: A 750 ml double-wall steel bottle with a push-pull cap and a matching aluminium cage. The cage mounts on standard frame bolts.

reviews.body: Cage holds the bottle firmly over rough roads. Screws were included in the box.
Keeps water cool for a couple of hours on my morning rides. A little heavy but sturdy.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cycling.name: Floor Bike Pump
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cycling.description: A steel-barrel floor pump with a pressure gauge, wide base and a dual-head valve that fits both common valve types. Maximum pressure is 160 psi.

reviews.body: The gauge is easy to read and the head locks on without hissing. Fills a tyre in under a minute.
Base is wide so it does not tip over. Handle is plastic but feels solid enough.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cycling.name: Padded Cycling Gloves
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cycling.description: Half-finger gloves with gel padding in the palm, a breathable stretch back and a terry cloth patch on the thumb. They are sold in sizes M, L and XL.

reviews.body: The palm padding is comfortable on longer rides and the fit is snug. Size L was right for me.
Stitching is neat and the velcro closure holds well. Thumb patch is useful on hot days.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cycling.name: LED Bike Light Set
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cycling.description: A set of front and rear LED lights with three modes each, powered by rechargeable batteries through a USB cable. Both lights attach to the handlebar or seat post with silicone straps.

reviews.body: Bright enough for dark lanes and straps fit my handlebar without any tools. Charging cable was included.
Battery lasted about four hours on the steady mode. Rear light is easy to see from behind.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cycling.name: Cable Bike Lock
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cycling.description: A 1.2 m braided steel cable lock with a combination of four digits and a vinyl outer coating. It is thin and light enough to coil around the seat post.

reviews.body: Easy to set the number and coils neatly under the saddle. Good for short stops outside a shop.
Coating protects my frame from scratches. The dials turn smoothly and the cable is thick.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cycling.name: Gel Saddle Cover
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cycling.description: A stretchy cover with a gel layer, fitting most standard saddles up to 28 cm wide. It has a drawstring at the back and a non-slip underside.

reviews.body: Quick to fit with the drawstring and does not shift while pedalling. Much softer than the stock seat.
Comfortable, but it was a tight fit on my narrow saddle and sat a bit loose at the front. Works okay after tightening.

sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cycling.name: Handlebar Phone Mount
sports-fitness-outdoor-play-cycling.description: A rotating mount with adjustable spring arms for phones between 4.7 and 6.8 inches. It clamps on handlebars from 22 to 32 mm with a rubber lining.

reviews.body: Holds my phone steady on bumpy roads and the clamp is padded. Takes under a minute to fit.
Rotates easily to portrait or landscape. Packaging was minimal but nothing was damaged.
